description:
## What

Tracking bead: re-evaluate the codesign differential approach if a purpose-aware oracle becomes available. Currently PKIX-fmtv.24 implements composed-oracle differential because no single-tool oracle exists.

## Re-evaluation triggers

Reopen / re-scope if any of these emerge:

- **pyca-cryptography adds `PolicyBuilder.build_codesign_verifier`** or equivalent. Would replace the composed oracle with a single purpose-aware call, matching the TLS server/client pattern.
- **OpenSSL adds `verify -purpose codesign`**. Would enable a direct OpenSSL diff (the original PKIX-fmtv.18.5 framing). Unlikely; OpenSSL's purpose list has been stable for years.
- **A new external oracle emerges** (osslsigncode adding chain-verify mode, signtool exposing a chain-only check, a new pkilint code-signing module). Would either replace or augment the composed oracle.
- **Composed oracle proves brittle in practice**: pyca chain-walk primitives change shape, or maintaining the EKU check becomes expensive. Triggers a switch to all-OpenSSL composition (the rejected alternative in PKIX-fmtv.24).

## Action when triggered

Open this bead, file follow-up under PKIX-fmtv.24 (or as sibling), simplify the codesign differential to use the purpose-aware oracle directly. Composed oracle in pkix-difftest stays available as a fallback / cross-check.

## Defer

Deferred 6 months. The triggers are external; no progress this bead can make autonomously. Surfacing on every `bd ready` is noise.

## Filed by

Filed 2026-05-13 alongside PKIX-fmtv.24 to record the known gap explicitly. AGENTS.md prelaunch framing: design for the eventual complete shape — that includes tracking known coverage gaps without committing work prematurely.
title: Track: revisit codesign differential if purpose-aware oracle emerges
